snippet.title: Rawyokan PC & Android Trailer
snippet.description:
The one button fighting game inspired by the classics. Rawyokan is a single player fighting game with focus on simplicity – one button allows the player to unleash a series of strikes to the opponent or parry incoming attacks when timed correctly. Links below.

Rawyokan is available NOW at:
PC via Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3543390/Rawyokan/ 
Android via Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=rykdev.rykdev.Rawyokan

Stream Rawyokan MUSIC at:
YouTube: https://music.youtube.com/playlist?list=OLAK5uy_mT4bClczAGmiWCCr6sX6vC9DDdKoF-0-g&si=WdPlp7vV-qIYuHaP
Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/album/7FQTNPVEMOFBQSukNOX1Aq
iTunes: https://music.apple.com/us/album/rawyokan/1801120591

Try the FREE demo at:
gx.games: https://gx.games/games/cnna71/rawyokan-free
itch.io: https://rykdev.itch.io/rawyokan-free
